content:
We are beta-testing DocNextGen, a new documentation generation tool based on jixia that aims at

  • Better integration with mathlib-informal, the informal description of each item in Mathlib
  • Easier navigation
  • Preview box on links
  • Modernized UI
  • Modular design, with separated data-extraction and presentation logic

Right now it can be accessed from LeanSearch, by clicking the "Doc-Next-Gen (beta)" link, or by going to https://leansearch.net/doc/Mathlib.html.

We are planning to publish the source code soon, and host it from a standalone domain. Meanwhile, we would like to hear your feedback!
It would be great if you could open and link to a discussion thread for this, @Tony Beta Lambda! :slight_smile:
Which channel seems appropriate? @Justin Asher
General would be good, @Tony Beta Lambda.
